source_metadata.exact_title: Clinical characteristics and outcomes of invasive Listeria monocytogenes infection: a 45-year retrospective study at a U.S. Tertiary Center

source_consistency_findings: Methods describes a retrospective cohort across Mayo Clinic Health System sites, while Discussion/Limitations describes the study as single-center; the source does not reconcile this wording.
Results prose reports median treatment duration 21 days (IQR 21–28), whereas Table 1 reports 21 days (IQR 14–28). Both assertions were retained as separate atoms and tagged.
Results prose attributes the adjunctive-gentamicin 90-day mortality hazard ratio to Table 4, but the rendered Table 4 does not display a gentamicin row.
Figure 1 reports fever absent in 32%, whereas Table 1 reports fever present in 62%; these figures are not complementary and are left unreconciled.
Figure 1 reports rhombencephalitis in 42%, whereas Results text reports 5/13 (39%) among imaged neurolisteriosis patients.
missing_source_material: Supplementary Tables 1–5 and Supplementary Figure 1 are cited in the article but were not embedded as PDF attachments and no separate supplementary files were present in the designated source folder.
extraction_limitations: The evaluated PDF is an accepted manuscript and may differ from the final version of record.
No external clinical-practice verification was performed; source claims were extracted as reported.
Supplementary-only numerical details were not invented or imported from outside sources.
